query: Trump approval rating independent voters latest poll

results.content:
Trump’s net approval among independents improved by 16 points, moving from minus 53 in the August 7-10 poll to minus 37 in the August 21-24 survey.

That was the largest change among the five groups. Independents remain a politically important audience because they are not formally aligned with either major party, although the polling comparison does not show how many are likely to vote or which candidates they may support in November. The biggest decline was in his handling of inflation, falling from 31% positive in October to 15%.

results.content: According to the poll’s bipartisan analysis, the erosion is concentrated among independent voters, more than 70% of whom disapprove of Trump, with the disapproval described as especially intense. Trump continues to perform well with voters 65 and older and those without a college degree, groups that have consistently backed him, while younger voters and women expressed sharply negative views.
